requestedChange: Anonymous Community authors must not be identifiable by ordinary users through UI or APIs; authorized Admin attribution remains available.

found.impact: The anonymous media path begins with the uploader Auth UUID, which can correlate with a known public profile-photo URL. Text-only author redaction did not cover this channel.

implementedLocally: Feed RPC returns anonymous-media:<post ID>, not the Storage path, for all anonymous media.
Revoke authenticated raw-table media_url column reads; retain other safe column reads.
Restrictive Storage SELECT policy prevents other members from listing/signing/downloading anonymous uploader paths. Owners can still clean up their uploads; authorized Admin retains access.
community-media POST verifies the user and room membership, then returns at most 50 opaque HMAC media links without author identifiers.

GET/HEAD validate signature and expiry, reject deleted/non-anonymous posts, stream only allowed image/video types and support single-range video requests. Storage headers, redirects and detailed upstream errors are not exposed.
Frontend resolves anonymous URLs once per page and batches normal Storage signing. It never falls back to author paths for anonymous posts.
A preview failure after successful creation cannot delete the committed upload or encourage duplicate posting.
